summary: Travelers is the name given to those who walk among the stars: the six Hearthian astronauts of Outer Wilds Ventures, Solanum (the last Nomai of her clan), and the Prisoner (an inhabitant of the Stranger). Each Traveler plays a musical instrument.

behavior: Each Traveler plays a musical instrument.
lore: The Travelers are those who walk among the stars.
The Travelers include the Hearthian astronauts of Outer Wilds Ventures.
The Travelers include Solanum, the last Nomai of her clan.
The Travelers include the Prisoner, an inhabitant of the Stranger who let the Eye of the Universe's signal transmit for the last time.
The Hearthian travelers are: the Protagonist, Chert, Esker, Feldspar, Gabbro, and Riebeck.
